title: Empty Cauldrons
description: EmptyCauldrons lets dispensers interact with cauldrons, filling and emptying them using buckets. It supports water, lava, and powder snow, integrates with hoppers, and works seamlessly on Spigot 1.21.x.
body:
EmptyCauldrons upgrades dispensers with proper cauldron handling.
They fill and empty cauldrons using water, lava, or powder snow buckets. A single redstone pulse handles it. Full cauldrons get emptied, empty cauldrons get filled.

Hoppers under the cauldron pull the returned bucket straight in. Without a hopper, the item drops on the ground. Works reliably in automated farms and technical redstone systems.

Runs on Spigot 1.21.x. No config.

If you want new features, drop a comment. I read them often and I'm open to adding more.

[CurseForge Comments](https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/bukkit-plugins/empty-cauldrons)
